mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a short-term sell-off in equities as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 220 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 550.0 (thousand units) signals a contraction in the residential sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 550.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average signals an impending slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS declines below its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
